viewCommand.label: Show / adjust command (anyone shows; mods can adjust, e.g. !squats -5)

lockCommand.label: Lock command (mods) - gifted subs stop adding, manual controls still work

unlockCommand.label: Unlock command (mods) - gifted subs start adding again

whoCanManage.label: Who can lock, reset and adjust the counter

startCount.label: Starting squat count (applies on the very first load only)

carryLeftover.label: Carry leftover subs over: gifted subs short of a block are kept, so 3 and then 3 more make a block of 5

countSingleGifts.label: Count a single gifted sub (one sub towards a block)

countNewSubs.label: Also count new subs, resubs and Prime subs (one each)

maxCount.label: Highest the count can go (0 for no limit)

debug.label: Log each gifted-sub event to the browser console (for troubleshooting)

label.label: Caption under the number (leave blank for just the number, like the example)

showFloat.label: Float a little +N above the box when squats are added

floatPlus.label: Text before the floating number when squats are added (the + in +15)

floatSuffix.label: Text after the floating number (for example squats)

showLock.label: Show a little padlock on the sticker while the count is locked

showTail.label: Show the little circle tail under the sticker

countScale.label: Size of the number compared with the default (1 is the default)

labelScale.label: Size of the caption compared with the default (1 is the default)

floatScale.label: Size of the floating +N compared with the default (1 is the default)

radius.label: Corner roundness, as a percentage of the box's smaller side

paddingV.label: Space above and below the contents, as a percentage of the box's smaller side

paddingH.label: Space either side of the contents, as a percentage of the box's smaller side

gap.label: Space between the number and the caption, as a percentage of the box's smaller side

tilt.label: Tilt in degrees (negative leans left, 0 is straight)

borderWidth.label: Outline width in pixels (0 for none)

textShadow.label: Soft shadow behind the text, to help it read over bright scenes

labelOpacity.label: Caption opacity (0 is invisible, 1 is solid)

labelSpacing.label: Space between the caption's letters, in em

themePreset.label: Style preset (pick Custom to use your own colours below)

colorAccent.label: Box colour (used when the preset is Custom)

boxOpacity.label: Box and floating chip opacity (used when the preset is Custom; 0 is invisible, 1 is solid)

colorBg.label: Light tone: the number, caption, outline and padlock (used when the preset is Custom)

colorCount.label: Number colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorLabel.label: Caption colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorBorder.label: Outline colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorLock.label: Padlock colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorFloat.label: Floating +N text colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorFloatBg.label: Floating +N background colour (used when the preset is Custom)

animations.label: Animate (untick to switch every animation off)

popScale.label: How far the sticker swells when the count changes (1 for no swell)

floatSeconds.label: Seconds the floating +N stays on screen

soundsEnabled.label: Play sounds (untick to mute everything, keeping the files)

giftSound.label: Sound when a gift adds squats. Leave empty for none.

lockSound.label: Sound when the count is locked. Leave empty for none.

unlockSound.label: Sound when the count is unlocked. Leave empty for none.

btnMinus.label: Take one block of squats off

btnLock.label: Lock or unlock the count (gifted subs stop or start adding)
